title: BackgroundTask starts before the response has been sent when BaseHTTPMiddleware is in the stack
author: Mukller
body_preview: With a `BaseHTTPMiddleware` anywhere in the stack, a `BackgroundTask` attached to a response starts running **before the last byte of the response has been sent** to the client. The [background docs](https://www.starlette.io/background/) state:  > A background task should be attached to a response, and will run only once the response has been sent.  **Version:** starlette 1.6.0 **Python:** 3.13.14...
